method: Independent source-blind ordinary visible play using only the existing playtest driver at http://127.0.0.1:5173/. Read driver help first, then Mission Brief and How to Play before deployment. Inspected every captured JPEG before deciding the next action. Exactly two attempts; no third attempt or rescore.

attempts.route: Walked past induction guard, strafed west while firing ineffectively, sprinted north, used facility map to approach West Archive, crossed to East Archive, approached Heart diagonally, then attempted straight backward sprint toward extraction.
mistakes: Fired into empty yard after passing the guard rather than turning to engage.
Initially approached pylons rather than the receiver floor position and needed several corrections.
Repeated M inputs appeared not to close the map in several captures; eventually the overlay was gone during the eastward crossing.
Long backward return through the central route was fatal; did not inspect mid-return or establish a protected route.

attempts.route: Aimed and fired at induction guard, reloaded, initially collided with west low cover, moved around its right edge, recovered West then East then Heart. Turned toward return, collided with central wall, moved sideways around it and sprinted to extraction. Reached near floor ring but died outside it.
mistakes: Used long movement intervals and hit low cover and a wall.
At extraction, moved the wrong lateral direction and remained 0.4 m outside the ring before the final wrong-direction step and reload wait; did not upload.
Spent shots without aligning with later threats and did little to control accumulated enemies.

strengths.observation: Consistent teal/amber industrial art direction, rain, wet ground reflections, oversized relay and coherent menu/end screens create a recognizable atmosphere.
Mission goals and recovery success are explicit; recovered names and numbered objective tiles clearly acknowledge progress.
Precise optic shooting produced a clear critical elimination on the induction guard. Side routes and cover permitted a much longer second return despite little combat.
Extraction readout gave useful concrete edge distance, allowing recognition that the player was still outside the valid zone.

problems.observation: The visible handbook panel clipped the lower prose: the shield sentence and threat-visor explanation were not visible in the JPEG despite appearing in driver dialog text. The important advanced explanations are dense for onboarding.

Pylon and receiver positions are easy to confuse. Several apparently close approaches produced approach/move-closer instructions before I found the valid position. Briefing does explain the receiver offset, but this remained a practical first-play friction.

Facility map was useful but dominated the center of the view during live danger, and my repeated M actions did not visibly dismiss it on several paused/resumed captures. Cannot distinguish driver timing interaction from normal game input behavior.

Enemies often sat near screen edges or behind the player while broad threat chevrons accumulated. I could read danger but had difficulty turning that into an accurate target choice, especially at extraction.
Environment remains visibly simple in geometry and repeated materials, with block-like enemies and sparse distant boundary. Cohesive presentation exceeds the asset/detail variety observed.

map.observation: Large north-up facility plan labeled Medical Bay, South Intake, Central Yard, East Works, West/East Archive, Heart and Extraction; showed player triangle, receivers and cover. Used it to orient toward West and plan the west-east-heart route. No assumption that its presence implied enjoyment.

coverageLimits: Two deaths, no victory or completed extraction upload; no upload decay behavior observed.
One ordinary dash during return; no confirmed phase evade or charge break.
Did not use jump, inspect settings, read recovered-memory prose, or explore every lane.
Screenshot/action driver with pauses and multi-second action intervals differs from uninterrupted human mouse play; long movement mistakes retained.
No hardware FPS measurement, audio enjoyment judgment, perfection certification, source inspection, tests, hidden state, or debug evaluation.
